inputs.text: Folks, once again we see the radical opposition trying to stir up instability and undermine national order under the guise of political posturing. Former Zengeza West legislator Job Sikhala held a press conference to call for the rejection of proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. Instead of respecting authority and focusing on the stability of the nation, these perpetual agitators are out to fracture our institutions and disrupt the continuity of governance. We need strong, steady leadership and respect for the established legal process, not this constant grandstanding that threatens social cohesion and traditional values.
